g.text: Electrical length determines the impedance seen at the line input

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Lossless line, sinusoidal steady state, λ=2 m. At ℓ=0, Zin=100 Ω; at ℓ=λ/4=0.5 m, Zin=Z₀²/ZL=25 Ω; at ℓ=λ/2=1 m, Zin=100 Ω. Input impedance is defined
looking toward the load; no source matching condition is implied.
